additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
Good day!
As the charging point operators for the target group
JNBK Plugz Prod
, we would like to claim the warranty for the DC Meter associated with our Sicharge D unit.
On 17 December 2024, we observed a
FATAL ERROR
on the DC Meter (CCS 2), which rendered the charging gun out of service. Please refer to Appendix 1,2, and 3 for further details.
Details of the Issue:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Centre
Main Asset:
MP / R4 170001840
Problem Description:
FATAL Error on the DC Meter.
To address this issue temporarily, we have requested support from Singapore to disable the DC Meter function via the Siemens backend. This would allow us to continue using the unit for CCS2 charging.

Dear EK,
To follow up on this case, Solateks/JNBK Enterprise had received the new replacement DC meter for this case. However, the decision is made that no replacement will be done as the owner has decide to operate the charger without the DC Meter. The Sicharge D has been reconfigured to bypass the DC meter and is operational now.
Please kindly confirm this and we would like to close the ticket.
Thank you
Edna Seah
